app_store.name: Tern: Assistant That Asks
app_store.subtitle: Email, calendar, apps, tasks
app_store.promotional_text: Tern reads your inbox, books time and works in your apps. It asks before anything is sent or changed. Free with your own Gemini key.
app_store.description:
Tern is an assistant that gets errands done in your own accounts, and asks first.

Ask in plain words: summarise my unread email, draft replies, find an hour on Thursday, archive the receipts. Tern shows each step it takes. Anything that sends, changes or deletes waits for your OK, and you can edit it before it goes.

What you get:
- Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive
- Notion, Linear, Canva, Jira and any app with an MCP server, plus thousands more through Zapier
- Tasks that run on a schedule and email you the result
- Think mode, live web search with sources, and image making

Free. Bring a free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.
app_store.whats_new: Tasks: schedule work and get the result by email.
